summary: This game is primarily made for kids to learn. The young astronauts get to experience what it would be like to be located on Mars.
details:
The project works in a way for children to maybe find their future job. They learn what resources Mars has and how they can use them to their advantage.

-The website for the game primarily uses CSS, JavaScript, Vite(Node), Tailwind, HTML5

-The game is primarily built using CodeBlocks on GDevelop.

Our project is creative because it's really rare to see someone go for the easier option theese days. Instead of just wanting the win we do this because we help the new generations advance, plus about the easier/harder option, people tend to pick the harder one and have a bad outcome.
